understanding.goal_understanding: The goal of the game was to navigate each level’s grid and complete all goal cells. A goal cell is completed by stepping onto it while carrying a piece whose shape, color, and rotation exactly match that goal’s required attributes. Completing all goals in a level advances to the next level, and completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (e.g., MOVE_NORTH/SOUTH/EAST/WEST) to move around the grid; walls can block movement so your position may not change. You carry a piece with three attributes: shape, color, and rotation. Landing on modifier tiles changes these attributes: shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. The game reports which attributes do not match a goal and may point to relevant modifier tile locations. Each action consumes stamina; when stamina reaches 0, you lose a life and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
